description: The Glass House, an architectural three-level townhouse curated by La Collection France, nestled on a cobblestoned street at the foot of the Sacré-Cœur and steps from the Montmartre funicular. Flooded with natural light through steel-frame windows and a glass atrium, this rare 160 m² residence blends Parisian charm with modern design, featuring exposed brick walls and double-height ceilings.An exclusive retreat for families, creatives, and design lovers seeking the true Montmartre experience.The spaceTo save this exceptional property to your favorites, tap ❤️ in the top right corner.Spread across three elegant floors, The Glass House combines contemporary comfort, refined design, and distinctive architectural character. An exceptional Parisian home for stays throughout the city’s most celebrated calendar moments, it offers an elegant base for Paris Fashion Week, Haute Couture Week, Men’s Fashion Week, Paris Design Week, Maison&Objet, Art Basel Paris, Paris Photo, Roland-Garros, and other major international events. Stylish yet inviting, the house provides a rare sense of space and privacy in Paris, making it equally suited to fashion and creative professionals, discerning travelers, families, and extended stays.Ground FloorAn airy open-plan living and dining area with soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass. Designer seating, curated art, and a Smart TV create a warm, sophisticated atmosphere.Beneath a striking glass roof, the dining area seats eight and opens onto a private patio, perfect for breakfast al fresco or an evening apéritif.The sleek kitchen is fully equipped with an induction hob, oven, dishwasher, full-size refrigerator, Nespresso machine, and cookware for preparing gourmet meals.First FloorOne generous bedroom with a queen-size bed, with storage, and
